metadata.title: Eighties Pop Portrait with Vertical Script

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key studio portrait of a woman in a white wrap top against a white background, featuring a prominent vertical script logo in red on the right side. The composition is defined by sharp contrasts between the warm skin tones, the stark white clothing/background, and the bold red graphic elements.
coreVisualRelationships: The vertical orientation of the text mirrors the upward reach of the subject's arm.
The red of the lips and nails is echoed in the color of the graphic lettering.
The white clothing blends into the white background, creating a floating effect for the subject's face and torso.
The diagonal lines of the wrap top's ties contrast with the verticality of the text.
coreInvariants: Primary accent color of vibrant red

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, scaled from the waist up with an arm raised above the head.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bold red script on the right margin.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows the raised arm upward, then drops down the vertical text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space on the right and top, used to isolate the subject and the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White (background and clothing) providing a clean, high-contrast canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and dark hair providing the central organic focus.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red used for lips, nails, and the large-scale vertical typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (brightness) throughout, with high saturation reserved specifically for the red accents.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to white, red, and natural skin/hair tones.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme vertical elongation of ascenders and descenders
Variable stroke width with sharp, tapered terminals
Integrated horizontal speed lines cutting through the base of the text
characterSpecificRedesigns: The final character transitions into three parallel horizontal bars that ground the vertical composition.

composition.relationshipToImage: parallel to the frame edge, balancing the subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Standalone custom lettering with no secondary typeface to maintain focus on the graphic brand.
graphicDevices: Extended swash on the initial capital letter

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 80s energy and fluid stroke movement.
Necessary to achieve the specific vertical elongation and integrated bars.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio portrait of a woman with 80s styling, wearing a white wrap-around top, posed with one arm raised over her head against a seamless white background. Ensure red lipstick and nails are visible.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a custom red cursive script vertically along the right edge, rotated 90 degrees clockwise. The script should feature long, elegant swashes and terminate in three horizontal bars at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the text rotated exactly 90 degrees?
Does the white clothing blend into the white background?
Is the red color consistent between the lips and the text?
Are the three horizontal bars present at the end of the script?

mustRedesign: The specific name/text must be replaced with a generic placeholder or different name.
Any specific brand logos or jewelry details.
postGenerationChecks: Verify the vertical text does not overlap the subject.
Ensure the red is vibrant and not orange-leaning.
Confirm the 80s 'glamour' photographic style is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key portrait + white-on-white wardrobe + vertical 90-degree script + red accent color = 80s Pop Aesthetic.
